text: DRUG INTERACTIONS THERE HAVE BEEN RARE REPORTS OF SIGNIFICANT RESPIRATORY DEPRESSION, STUPOR AND/OR HYPOTENSION WITH THE CONCOMITANT USE OF LOXAPINE AND LORAZEPAM. THE RISK OF USING LOXAPINE IN COMBINATION WITH CNS-ACTIVE DRUGS HAS NOT BEEN SYSTEMATICALLY EVALUATED. THEREFORE, CAUTION IS ADVISED IF THE CONCOMITANT ADMINISTRATION OF LOXAPINE AND CNS-ACTIVE DRUGS IS REQUIRED. CONTRAINDICATIONS LOXAPINE IS CONTRAINDICATED IN COMATOSE OR SEVERE DRUG-INDUCED DEPRESSED STATES (ALCOHOL, BARBITURATES, NARCOTICS, ETC.). LOXAPINE IS CONTRAINDICATED IN INDIVIDUALS WITH KNOWN HYPERSENSITIVITY TO DIBENZOXAZEPINES.
